shared_elements: large upright monolith carved in low relief with an anthropomorphic reading (head/upper block above a body-slab)
horizontal dividing band across the body separating upper and lower zones
relief motifs organised in stacked horizontal registers
curvilinear/sinuous elongated forms on the body
justification: Both are vertical anthropomorphic-seeming monoliths whose front face carries schematic low-relief motifs stacked in registers, divided by a horizontal band across the mid-body, and both include disc/oval and elongated sinuous forms. But the actual iconography differs fundamentally: A is dominated by a sculpted human head with abstract curvilinear and circular ornament, while B presents a figurative animal repertoire (a row of quadrupeds along the top, profile beasts, a bird, a small human-like figure) and a chevron band, none of which recurs in A.
